LanguageData.CC_Settings_GodWorship_Tip: Places dedicated to a god and the offerings carried there, prayer in hard moments, the gods' festivals on the calendar, vows, a priest and the council's questions about the gods, the gods in dreams, and crises of faith. Off: none of it, and the gods themselves go on as before.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_GodWorship: Shrines, offerings, prayer, festivals, vows, a priest and the gods in dreams.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Gizmo_Desc: Give this place to one of the gods. Someone of the colony walks over and says the words there, and it becomes the god's {SHRINE}: offerings are carried to it, prayers said at it, and the god's festival rite held there.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Gizmo_Of: Given to {GOD}, {GODOF}. The colony's standing with {GOD}: {WORD}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Gizmo_NoGods: The colony knows no god yet.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_DedicateAsked: Someone will walk over and give the {PLACE} to {GOD}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_DedicateLetGo: Nobody was free to dedicate the {PLACE}, and it was let be.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Inspect_Temple: A temple of {GOD}. The colony's standing: {WORD}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dedicated_Believed: {PAWN} gave the {PLACE} to {GOD} with the words the colony knows. It is {SHRINE} now.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dedicated_Felt: {PAWN} gave the {PLACE} to {GOD}, and it is {SHRINE} now. Some say a warmth settled on it as the words were said.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dedicated_Walking: {PAWN} gave the {PLACE} to {GOD}, and {GOD} took it: it shone a moment, and everyone near felt it. It is {SHRINE} now.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Report_Dedicate_NoGod: dedicating a place to a god.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Taken_Believed: The offering at {SHRINE} is gone: {WHAT}. The colony says {GOD} took it.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Taken_Felt: The offering at {SHRINE} was gone by morning: {WHAT}. Nobody saw it go, and some say {GOD} came for it in the night.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Taken_Walking: {GOD} took the offering from {SHRINE} before everyone's eyes: {WHAT}, gone in a breath of light.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Animal: An animal came to {SHRINE} and ate the offering: {WHAT}. The colony says {GOD} sent it.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Passerby: Someone passing took the offering from {SHRINE} with them: {WHAT}. The colony says {GOD} sent them.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Spoiled: The offering at {SHRINE} lay there and spoiled: {WHAT}. The colony says {GOD} took what it wanted from it.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Taken_Returned: Nobody came for the offering at {SHRINE}, and it went back to the stores: {WHAT}. The colony says {GOD} took the thought.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Answer_Sickness_Believed: {SICK}'s {ILLNESS} eased in the night after {PAWN} prayed. The colony says {GOD} heard.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Answer_Sickness_Felt: {SICK}'s {ILLNESS} eased in the night after {PAWN} prayed. Some say {GOD} laid a hand on {SICK}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Answer_Sickness_Walking: {GOD} heard {PAWN}: a light stood over {SICK} a moment, and the {ILLNESS} loosened its hold.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Answer_Death_Believed: {PAWN} prayed for {DEAD}, and the grief let go a little. The colony says {GOD} is keeping {DEAD} now.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Answer_Death_Felt: {PAWN} prayed for {DEAD}, and the grief let go a little. Some say {GOD} will bring {DEAD} to {PAWN} in a dream.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Answer_Death_Walking: {GOD} answered {PAWN}'s prayer for {DEAD}: {DEAD} is safe across, and will come to say so in a dream.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Answer_Raid_Believed: {PAWN} prayed before the fight and came up from it steady-handed. The colony says {GOD} was with them.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Answer_Raid_Felt: {PAWN} prayed to {GOD} before the fight and came up from it steady-handed. Some say {GOD} steadied {PAWN}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Answer_Raid_Walking: {GOD} answered {PAWN}'s prayer: {PAWN} rose from it with a fighter's fire in the eyes.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Answer_Drought_Believed: Rain at last, the evening after the colony prayed for it. The colony says {GOD} sent it.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Answer_Drought_Felt: Rain at last, the evening after the colony prayed for it. Some say {GOD} opened the sky.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Answer_Drought_Walking: {GOD} answered the colony's prayers: the sky opened with thunder, and the rain came.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Why_Credit_Raid: the colony came through the raid, as {PAWN} prayed
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_HungerDue_Believed: {WHAT} is gone from the stores, and nobody will own to taking it. The colony says {GOD} came for its due.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_HungerDue_Felt: {WHAT} is gone from the stores, and nobody took it. Some say {GOD} came back for its due.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_HungerDue_Walking: {GOD} took its due in the night: {WHAT}, gone from the stores without a trace.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dev_NoGod: {0} has no god to turn to.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Cause_Unanswered: a prayer to {GOD} that went unanswered
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Crisis_Sickness: {PAWN} prayed to {GOD} for {ABOUT}, and {ABOUT} died. {PAWN} isn't sure of {GOD} any more, and some say {GOD} turned away.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Crisis_Death: {PAWN} prayed to {GOD} for {ABOUT}, and felt nothing come back. {PAWN} isn't sure of {GOD} any more.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Crisis_Raid: {PAWN} prayed to {GOD} before the fight, and {ABOUT} fell in it. {PAWN} isn't sure of {GOD} any more.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Crisis_Drought: {PAWN} prayed to {GOD} for rain, and none came. {PAWN} isn't sure of {GOD} any more, and some say {GOD} turned away.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Turned: {PAWN} has turned from {FROM} to {GOD}, {GODOF}, and prays to {GOD} now.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_BickerLog: {A} and {B} argued over whether it was {GODA} or {GODB} who sent the rain.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Vowed_NoMeat: {PAWN} has vowed to {GOD}: no meat until {ABOUT} is well.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Vowed_Pilgrimage: {PAWN} has vowed {GOD} a pilgrimage on foot.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Vowed_BeastSpared: {PAWN} has vowed to {GOD} that the colony will hunt no {BEAST} this season.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_VowKept_NoMeat: {PAWN} kept the vow to {GOD}: no meat until {ABOUT} was well.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_VowKept_Pilgrimage: {PAWN} kept the vow to {GOD}: the pilgrimage is walked.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_VowKept_Temple: {PAWN} kept the vow to {GOD}: the temple stands.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_VowKept_BeastSpared: {PAWN} kept the vow to {GOD}: not one {BEAST} fell to the colony this season.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_VowBroken_NoMeat: {PAWN} broke the vow to {GOD} of no meat until {ABOUT} was well.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_VowBroken_Pilgrimage: {PAWN} broke the vow to {GOD}: the pilgrimage was never walked.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_VowBroken_Temple: {PAWN} broke the vow to {GOD}: no temple was raised.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_VowBroken_BeastSpared: {PAWN}'s vow to {GOD} is broken: a {BEAST} fell to the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_How_ToTheEnd: {ABOUT} didn't live to see it, and the vow was kept to the end.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_How_Days: Twenty days, and not a bite of meat.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Why_GreatVow_Temple: {PAWN} kept a vow of a temple
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Why_GreatVow_Pilgrimage: {PAWN} kept a vow of a pilgrimage
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Why_Wrath: {PAWN} broke a vow to it, and it took it hard
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Wrath_Believed: The colony says {GOD} is angry with {PAWN} for the broken vow, and gives {PAWN} a wide berth.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Wrath_Felt: A shadow passed over {PAWN} that nobody could account for. Some say {GOD}'s anger is on {PAWN} for the broken vow.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Wrath_Walking: {GOD}'s anger fell on {PAWN} for the broken vow, and everyone saw the shadow of it.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_PilgrimOut: {PAWN} has set out on foot, on a pilgrimage to {GOD}'s holy place.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Why_Pilgrimage: {PAWN} walked a pilgrimage to its holy place
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Goal_PilgrimNot: not yet walked to {GOD}'s holy place
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Goal_TempleNone: {GOD} has no {SHRINE} in the colony yet
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Goal_TempleSome: {GOD}'s best room is {PERCENT} of the way to a temple
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Festival_Craft: the Fire of the Forge of {GOD}
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Festival_Dead: the Day of the Dead of {GOD}
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Harvest: bread from the new grain, and the first sheaf left at the god's place
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Storm: a cup poured out in the open, and a meal eaten under the sky
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Hunt: the season's best meat roasted whole, and the bones given back
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Healing: broth for everyone, and the year's healed sat at the head of the table
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_War: a soldier's meal, eaten standing, and the weapons laid out to be blessed
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Craft: the year's best work laid out, and the forge's fire relit
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Way: a place at the table kept for a stranger, and a coin for the road
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Dead: a place laid for each of the dead, and their names said aloud
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Night: a lamp kept burning till dawn, and honey cakes eaten in the dark
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Hearth: every fire fed, every door open, and bread broken together
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Wild: green bread and flowers, and nothing cut that day
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Waters: a catch shared and a coin thrown in the water
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Machine: every machine oiled and every light lit
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_Void: the shutters closed and the lamps lit, so that it passes by
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Dishes_None: a meal shared in the god's name
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_FestivalVisitors: People of {PEOPLE} have come for {GOD}'s festival.
LanguageData.CC_Cal_Origin_GodFestival: The festival of {GOD}, {GODEPITHET}, one of the colony's gods, on its day since {YEAR}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Why_DemandMet: it was brought what it asked for in a dream, {WHAT}
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_DemandIgnored: {GOD} asked in a dream for {WHAT} at its place, and nobody brought it.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Why_Honoured: the colony honours it this year, the year {YEAR}
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Unavailable_NoGod: The colony has no third god to honour.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Unavailable_NoShrine: {GOD} has no place in the colony to carry it to.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Unavailable_NoBeast: The beast isn't here any more.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Impact_Honour: {GOD} is the colony's god this year: its festival first, its prayers and rites a quarter more, and its rivals take note.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Impact_TempleVow: {PAWN} vows {GOD} a temple: a place of {GOD}'s in a room of {IMPRESSIVE} impressiveness or more, indoors, within {DAYS} days, or the vow is broken.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Impact_GiveBeast: {PET} is walked out and let go into the wild
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_DryBegins_Believed: The colony says {GOD} will keep the rain away for refusing it.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_DryBegins_Felt: The sky has gone hard and bright. Some say {GOD} will keep the rain away a while.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_DryBegins_Walking: {GOD} has turned the clouds away from the colony, and there will be no rain for a while.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_DryPass_Believed: The rain clouds passed over again.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_DryPass_Felt: Rain clouds came up and passed over. Some say {GOD} is still keeping the rain away.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_DryPass_Walking: The rain clouds broke apart overhead: {GOD} is still keeping the rain away.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_BeastGiven_Believed: {PET} went off into the wild, given to {GOD}.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_BeastGiven_Felt: {PET} went off into the wild. Some say {GOD} was waiting for it at the edge of the land.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_BeastGiven_Walking: {GOD} called {PET} to the edge of the land, and it went.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Week_Vow_NoMeat: {PAWN} keeps a vow to {GOD}: no meat until {ABOUT} is well
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Week_Vow_BeastSpared: {PAWN} has vowed {GOD} no {BEAST} hunted this season
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Week_VowTip_NoMeat: Kept when the sick one is well, or after twenty days; broken by a single meal with meat in it. Vegetarian meals in the stores help.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Week_VowTip_Pilgrimage: A life goal: on a free day they walk out to the god's holy place on the colony's land and pray there an hour.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Week_VowTip_Temple: Kept when a place of the god's stands indoors in a fine room (impressiveness 50 or more, 16 cells or more).
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Week_VowTip_BeastSpared: Broken if anyone of the colony kills an animal of that kind before the season is out.
LanguageData.CC_Wsh_Week_DemandTip: {PAWN} dreamt it. Someone will carry it there when they are free; let it go past three days, and the god is displeased.
